name: 72202 · Little Rock, AR
findings: ZIP 72202 (Little Rock) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72202 (Little Rock) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 72202 (Little Rock) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).
